summary: Frontend-only test of the 3 new UX improvements on the 'Create Production Order' tab of /production-confirmation (synthetic vms_session cookie, deleted after test; the create-and-release POST + status polls were MOCKED via page.route so NO real SAP Proposal/Order was created). VERIFIED WORKING: (1) Product ID typeahead - typing 'BK-00' shows data-testid=product-suggestions-dropdown with 7 real IDs from GET /api/products/search, clicking product-suggestion-BK-0021 fills the field and auto-triggers the source-of-supply lookup (picker rendered with 2 real models, site auto-filled P2). (2) Invalid product 'NOTAREALPRODUCT999' + blur -> red data-testid=product-not-recognized-warning renders and the submit click is blocked with the toast 'Product ID not recognized in SAP - pick one from the suggestions or check the spelling'; NO create-and-release request fired. (3) Site input disabled=true + helper 'Locked - set by the chosen Production Model above' when a model auto-filled it, and remains editable (typed P2 successfully) when no model was found. (4) UoM is now a Select (data-testid=create-proposal-uom-select-trigger), defaults to EA, exposes exactly 8 options (EA/KGM/MTR/LTR/PC/SET/BOX/TO), changing to KGM works. (5) Step-by-step progress panel (data-testid=create-proposal-progress-steps) renders all 4 steps with correct highlighting: at t0 step1 amber-pulsing '1 Submitting request to SAP', t+9s step1 green check + step2 amber, t+20s steps 1-3 green checks + step4 amber; button label mirrors the phase ('Creating Proposal in SAP... (8s)'), elapsed line updates, panel disappears when job status=done. Zero console errors in every flow. Regression on the Production Confirmation tab: Open Lots list rendered 113 rows / 100 distinct lots, Confirm Production Task dialog opens with component stock check, scrap-calc note, Confirmed Scrap and Post Confirmation controls - no console errors. TWO REAL DEFECTS FOUND around the blur-triggered lookup (details below).

ui_bugs.issue: FIRST click on 'Create Production Order' after interacting with the Product ID field is silently swallowed: the input's onBlur re-fires checkSourceOfSupply, which hides the Source-of-Supply picker (sosLoading) and shifts the button up by ~64px between mousedown and mouseup, so no click event lands (no POST, no toast). A second click works. Reproduced deterministically.

The elapsed-seconds counter only advances on each 4s poll tick (observed 0s -> 8s -> 20s), so it is not a live per-second counter as intended. Use a 1s setInterval for elapsedSeconds independent of the poll.

integration_issues.issue: FALSE 'Product ID not recognized in SAP' block for a VALID product. onBlur unconditionally re-runs checkSourceOfSupply (duplicate SAP call even when the ID did not change), which resets materialUuid=null while sosChecked stays true. Clicking submit during that in-flight lookup (SAP takes 3-20s) hits the guard `sosChecked && !materialUuid` and the submit is refused with 'Product ID not recognized in SAP...' for BK-0021 - a product whose lookup had already succeeded. Also loses the selected Production Model / logistic_relationship_uuid and the auto-filled Site during that window. Fix: skip the blur lookup when the trimmed ID equals the last looked-up ID, and either disable the submit button while sosLoading or await the in-flight lookup instead of blocking.

issues: 'Requested End Date' still uses the browser-native mm/dd/yyyy date input instead of the shadcn calendar (pre-existing, from iteration_87)

The SoS lookup state shows only plain text 'Checking available Production Models...' with no spinner/skeleton, and the picker block unmounts during it - causing the layout jump behind the swallowed-click bug

action_items: Skip the onBlur source-of-supply re-lookup when the Product ID hasn't changed (prevents the duplicate SAP call, the layout jump and the state reset)

Do not block submit on `sosChecked && !materialUuid` while sosLoading is true - either disable the submit button during the lookup or await it; today a valid product (BK-0021) is rejected with 'Product ID not recognized in SAP'
Reserve the SoS picker's vertical space (or render a skeleton) so the submit button doesn't move and swallow the user's first click
Drive elapsedSeconds from a 1s interval so the counter increments live instead of jumping every 4s
critical_code_review_comments: ProductionConfirmationPage.js is now 1021 lines - split CreateOrderTab / ConfirmDialog / HistoryDialog / ManageReasonsDialog into modules (>700-line guideline).

checkSourceOfSupply() swallows all errors into `setSosOptions([])` and leaves materialUuid null, so a transient 5xx/timeout on /source-of-supply-options renders the red 'Product ID not recognized in SAP' warning and blocks submit even for a valid product - distinguish 'not found' (material_uuid null with HTTP 200) from a request failure.
The suggestions dropdown uses onMouseDown + preventDefault while the input also has onBlur -> two competing handlers on the same gesture; consolidate to a single 'resolve product' path.

success_rate.frontend: 6/8 scenarios fully pass; 2 defects found (swallowed first submit click, false not-recognized block during in-flight blur lookup)

seed_data_creation: One synthetic super_admin auth_users/auth_sessions pair (oid TEST-QA-OID) via tests/_setup_pc_session.py - DELETED after the test. No SAP writes (create-and-release POST and status polls were intercepted/mocked in the browser).
test_credentials: No end-user login; Entra ID SSO simulated with a synthetic vms_session cookie per /app/memory/test_credentials.md (created + deleted within this test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mint a cookie with `cd /app/backend && python tests/_setup_pc_session.py`, then page.context.add_cookies vms_session for domain sap-data-sync.preview.emergentagent.com, and delete the auth_users/auth_sessions docs afterwards. Tabs are role=tab 'Create Production Order' / 'Production Confirmation'. To exercise the stepper without touching SAP, page.route '**/api/production-confirmation/create-and-release-order' -> {job_id:'X'} and '**/.../status/**' -> cycling {status: running|creating_proposal|waiting_for_order|releasing_order|done}. Real product for happy path: BK-0021 (2 models, site P2, material_uuid a914bea5-2316-1ede-81ed-9392bca5ac10). Note the submit button needs TWO clicks today because of the blur/layout-shift bug - after a fix, verify one click suffices and that submitting right after a blur is not rejected as 'not recognized'.
rca_of_the_issue: The Product ID input's onBlur handler calls checkSourceOfSupply() unconditionally. Every blur (including the mousedown that precedes a submit click, or focusing any other field) clears materialUuid/sosOptions/selectedSosKey and sets sosLoading, which (a) unmounts the Source-of-Supply block, moving the submit button up ~64px so the pending click never fires, and (b) leaves sosChecked=true with materialUuid=null, so createProposal's `if (sosChecked && !materialUuid)` guard rejects a valid product with 'Product ID not recognized in SAP'. Both reproduced live on BK-0021 with the SAP write mocked.
